runtime_contract.optimizer_schedule: resident actor-before-critic including IQL V and Adam state

semantics.census: Every factual upstream issue throughout each half-open window; no stop after first eligible issue, no sampling or labels.
semantics.eligible: Both0/7.5-second commands are executable under unchanged F, plus all three history segments completed and observed strictly before issue.
semantics.covariates: Headway is the original unclipped raw forward/target minus backward/target deviation; third residual and actual mean_residual_scaled*60 use the same +/-7.5-second bins.
semantics.mapping: Native F uses the original canonical state and actor proposal. Shadow tail=proposal_hold/8; no_floor recomputes F with only completion floor removed. Condition counts and actual increments are distinct; clocks are read and never changed.
semantics.windows: Diagnostic support only; no service-reversal gate for the factual fresh-attribution experiment.
